metadata.description: Curated Claude Code + Codex CLI skills for the Aetheris Solutions agency workflow. Ships /aetheris-review (multi-agent PR review with Aetheris admin ticket integration) and /second-opinion (read-only Codex CLI fresh-perspective review), and grows as the team standardises shared workflows.

plugins.name: aetheris
plugins.description: Aetheris Solutions agency skills. /aetheris-review: multi-agent PR review with ticket integration — auto-detects the project from the repo URL via the aetheris-admin MCP, injects ticket acceptance criteria into every review agent, tiers findings into blocker / before-merge comments, and posts per-ticket findings back to Aetheris. /second-opinion: an independent, read-only Codex CLI review of the current diff/branch/commit for a fresh perspective from a different model — advisory only, never edits, report saved outside the repo.
